en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's read a book about patent laws
I want to scream really loud!
Let's make a tower of books

Ugh, patent laws...
What are they even good for?

All that paperwork is such a pain in the ass...
I'd rather use that time to invent.

So no, I don't wanna read some stupid
fucking book about patent laws!

Oh? If you can't stand the silence, then
have I got an invention for you!

I recorded a sample of my own hot and
heavy breathing!

So get naked, get some tissues ready, and
listen up!
<CLT=cltMIND>...Miu's panting echoed through the library.

Hah-hahaha!
Erect a tower or pitch a tent!

As long as you don't touch it in public,
the cops won't do shit!

Honestly, I just wanna see if a virgin like
you can even get it up to begin with!

<CLT=cltMIND>What...the hell...is
she talking about?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
(Hmph...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Miu's inner thoughts...?
